# certloom_team (Data Source)

Looks up a team by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "certloom_team" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `contact` (String) Team contact.
- `id` (String) Identifier.
